tasks.Overtime_Earnings_Calculation: Calculate Eliza's overtime earnings based on the identified overtime hours and a rate of 1.2 times her regular hourly rate.
tasks.Overtime_Hours_Identification: Identify the number of overtime hours worked beyond 40.
tasks.Regular_Earnings_Calculation: Calculate Eliza's earnings for the first 40 hours at her regular rate of $10 per hour.
tasks.Total_Earnings_Calculation: Sum up the total earnings from both regular and overtime calculations.
